complexityAnalysis.taskTitle: Build Search Interface and Filtering Components
complexityAnalysis.expansionPrompt: Break down the search interface implementation into components: SearchBar with debouncing and API integration, AutocompleteDropdown with keyboard navigation, FilterPanel with card type and category filters, SearchResults with list/map view toggle, URL state management, loading states, and error handling. Each subtask should focus on a specific UI component or feature integration with the mock API service.
complexityAnalysis.reasoning: High complexity due to multiple interactive components, real-time API integration, state management across components, keyboard navigation requirements, URL parameter synchronization, and various UI states (loading, error, empty). Requires careful coordination between search input, filters, and results display.
